title: Failed to remove PowerToys folder when updating from stable to Preview
author: maisondasilva

status.label: Installer design investigation queued
status.detail: The failure is independently corroborated and maps to scheduled-task cleanup, but the failing HRESULT and implementation-grade fix design are not established.

next_action.label: Investigate scheduled-task cleanup design
next_action.reason: Reproduce with logs and design safe task deletion behavior before approval.

judgment.rationale: The author supplied clear stable-to-Preview per-user steps, a maintainer independently sees the warning, and the source owner is identifiable.
evidence: The failure occurs upgrading a per-user WinGet stable installation with Preview x64.
The installer warns it failed to remove the PowerToys Task Scheduler folder.
Maintainer niels9001 reports seeing this for multiple versions and offered a reproducible machine.
RemoveScheduledTasksCA deletes tasks and then the folder; any surviving task or access failure emits the exact warning.
judgment.recommended_action: Develop an implementation-grade design after capturing the failing HRESULT, covering task collection mutation, permissions, stable/Preview coexistence, and install scopes.

issue_context.summary: Stable-to-Preview per-user upgrades can leave the PowerToys scheduled-task folder undeleted and display a warning, with independent maintainer corroboration.
known_information: The original install used WinGet per-user scope and upgrade used Preview x64.
The issue is Area-Setup/Install and milestoned for 0.102.
The custom action emits the exact warning after task or folder deletion failure.
inferences: A task may remain due to deletion failure or collection mutation, but the HRESULT is unknown.
Stable/Preview task naming or ownership may contribute, but is unconfirmed.
issue_context.analysis: This has a maintainer reproduction path and precise source owner, so it should advance to design investigation, but not approval until logs identify the operation and a safe cross-channel strategy.
initial_investigation: Confirmed it emits the issue's exact warning.
Reviewed history and found no linked issue-specific fix PR.

information_gaps.information: The failing Task Scheduler HRESULT and which task remains.
information_gaps.why_needed: Design differs for access denial, concurrent recreation, enumeration mutation, or channel ownership conflict.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Capture verbose installer logs and Task Scheduler folder contents during full design investigation.
